turns.text: Hey Lloyd, quick question. I was looking into that benchmark I told you about, RobotArena ∞. Do you have any notes on the source paper?
I can help you look for it. Do you recall the title or authors?
I don't remember the title, but I noted down the arXiv ID. It's arXiv paper 2510.23571.
Got it. I've made a note that RobotArena ∞ is associated with arXiv paper 2510.23571.
Thanks. Also, did you check if my coffee maker arrived? The tracking said it was out for delivery yesterday.
I don't have access to real-time tracking, but I can set a reminder to ask you later if you'd like.
Nah, I'll just wait. It's probably on my porch by now. Let me know if you find anything else about that paper.
Understood. I'll keep the arXiv ID in mind.
Lloyd, I'm back on RobotArena∞. I found the code and the verification process. It features a real-to-sim pipeline verified via GitHub repo and arXiv.
That sounds robust. So the pipeline uses both code and the paper for verification?
Exactly. It's a key feature they highlight. Anyway, unrelated, is it going to rain this weekend? I want to plan a hike.
I can check the forecast for your location once you confirm where you're planning to go.
I'm thinking about the trails near Lake Tahoe. Let me know if it looks clear.
I'll check the Lake Tahoe weather for this weekend.
Great. And just to reiterate for my notes later: RobotArena∞ features a real-to-sim pipeline verified via GitHub repo and arXiv.
Noted. I'll add that detail to your RobotArena∞ entry.
